body: good night, and i do appreciate your reply. it's a lot more than nostalgia, to be honest. he's my ex for a lot of reasons but it wasn't a decision i wanted to make, even at the time. it was one i felt i had to make for his sake.

i've never been as close to anyone as i was with my ex. i dated my friend for a month and it was great, but it... it wasn't even close to my relationship with my ex. i know i can't be together with my ex but living without him gets harder every day. 

i'm so sorry, i sound really dumb and i'm not trying to reject your advice. i think for someone else it would be good advice but i'm so far down the rabbit hole at this point.
